name: PageSetup
remarks: The PageSetup object contains all page setup attributes (left margin, bottom margin, paper size, and so on) as properties.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: BlackAndWhite
properties.description: True if elements of the document will be printed in black and white. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: BottomMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the bottom margin, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: CenterFooter
properties.description: Center aligns the footer information in the PageSetup object. Read/write String.

properties.name: CenterHeader
properties.description: Center aligns the header information in the PageSetup object. Read/write String.

properties.name: CenterHorizontally
properties.description: True if the sheet is centered horizontally on the page when it's printed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CenterVertically
properties.description: True if the sheet is centered vertically on the page when it's printed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Draft
properties.description: True if the sheet will be printed without graphics. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FirstPageNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the first page number that will be used when this sheet is printed. If xlAutomatic, Microsoft Excel chooses the first page number. The default is xlAutomatic (Constants). Read/write Long.

properties.name: FitToPagesTall
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of pages tall that the worksheet will be scaled to when it's printed. Applies only to worksheets. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: FitToPagesWide
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of pages wide that the worksheet will be scaled to when it's printed. Applies only to worksheets. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: FooterMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance from the bottom of the page to the footer, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: HeaderMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance from the top of the page to the header, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: LeftFooter
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment of text on the left footer of a workbook or section.

properties.name: LeftHeader
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment of text on the left header of a workbook or section.

properties.name: LeftMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the left margin, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlOrder value that represents the order that Microsoft Excel uses to number pages when printing a large worksheet.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPageOrientation value that represents the portrait or landscape printing mode.

properties.name: PaperSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the paper. Read/write XlPaperSize.

properties.name: PrintArea
properties.description: Returns or sets the range to be printed as a String using A1-style references in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: PrintGridlines
properties.description: True if cell gridlines are printed on the page. Applies only to worksheets. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintHeadings
properties.description: True if row and column headings are printed with this page. Applies only to worksheets. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintNotes
properties.description: True if cell notes are printed as end notes with the sheet. Applies only to worksheets. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintQuality
properties.description: Returns or sets the print quality. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PrintTitleColumns
properties.description: Returns or sets the columns that contain the cells to be repeated on the left side of each page, as a String in A1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: PrintTitleRows
properties.description: Returns or sets the rows that contain the cells to be repeated at the top of each page, as a String in A1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: RightFooter
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the right edge of the page and the right boundary of the footer. Read/write String.

properties.name: RightHeader
properties.description: Returns or sets the right part of the header. Read/write String.

properties.name: RightMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the right margin, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TopMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the top margin, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Zoom
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents a percentage (between 10 and 400 percent) by which Microsoft Excel will scale the worksheet for printing.

properties.name: PrintComments
properties.description: Returns or sets the way comments are printed with the sheet. Read/write XlPrintLocation.

properties.name: PrintErrors
properties.description: Sets or returns an XlPrintErrors constant specifying the type of print error displayed. This feature allows users to suppress the display of error values when printing a worksheet. Read/write.

properties.name: CenterHeaderPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the center section of the header. Used to set attributes about the picture.

properties.name: CenterFooterPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the center section of the footer. Used to set attributes about the picture.

properties.name: LeftHeaderPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the left section of the header. Used to set attributes about the picture.

properties.name: LeftFooterPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the left section of the footer. Used to set attributes about the picture.

properties.name: RightHeaderPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the right section of the header. Used to set attributes about the picture.

properties.name: RightFooterPicture
properties.description: Returns a Graphic object that represents the picture for the right section of the footer. Used to set attributes of the picture.

properties.name: OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter
properties.description: True if the specified PageSetup object has different headers and footers for odd-numbered and even-numbered pages. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter
properties.description: True if a different header or footer is used on the first page. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter
properties.description: Returns or sets if the header and footer should be scaled with the document when the size of the document changes. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AlignMarginsHeaderFooter
properties.description: Returns True for Excel to align the header and the footer with the margins set in the page setup options. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Pages
properties.description: Returns or sets the count or item number of the pages in the Pages collection.

properties.name: EvenPage
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment of text on the even page of a workbook or section.

properties.name: FirstPage
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment of text on the first page of a workbook or section.
